State predicates: HideForGameStart from LobbyRoot hideMenusForGameStart1; ShowSelectKorea15Plus requires PC+Zombies+opaque Korea eligibility; other states delegate exact DirectorUtility ShowDirectorSelect/Pregame/Private/Custom/Arena/ArenaMatchmaking/Theater/Public/Training. lobbyNav/showSelect/hide flags reevaluate state; network/client/input/xuid/time/spinner/stage/session changes refresh button state. unused_gamepad_button invokes LobbyAddLocalClient(event.controller or owner) then dispatches children. Non-PC Start opens StartMenu_Main; non-PC social requires online/nonLAN/nonguest/allowed/not-demo-disabled/not-training, while PC select Triangle activates featured. Square branches offline-demo LAN hold behavior or nonPC select featured activation. Escape/mouse-keyboard and Circle/gamepad have separate ordered chains: hide preview, clear selected client, cancel/leave applicable custom/arena/theater/public states subject to spinner/timer/host/eligibility, or PC select quit. Duplicate preview branches are preserved and may be shadowed by earlier identical predicates; no guessed simplification. Back opens AAR only when CanShowAAR and refreshes prompt. RTrigger gestures requires dvar lobby_gestures_enabled plus opaque hash_61E20A632CB63092; then alias/preserve-button/open selector. setState CallOriginalFirst hook conditionally opens AAR/refreshes contract/client updates or initializes training; external predicates keep non-HMH internals conditional. Close CallOriginalFirst hook clears saved state and OnDirectorClose; class __onClose registered via CallOriginalSecond outside selected body remains dependency. lobby room/isMatchmaking callbacks refresh room; hideMenusForGameStart1 plays hide clip+loses focus/hides cursor,0 plays default/unhides cursor. menu_loaded then optional restore/postload; PC branch additionally key-color/friends/Korea/navigation/ZM-availability hooks, console branch DirectorUtility.PostLoad only.
